newsitem.title: USA: Most GM, UAW bargainers adjourn talks.
newsitem.headline: Most GM, UAW bargainers adjourn talks.

text.p: General Motors Corp Thursday said most of the bargainers for the company and the United Auto Workers adjourned national contract negotiations until Friday morning.
GM spokesman Charles Licari said talks in several specific areas were scheduled to continue Thursday night, but full negotiations will resume Friday morning.
"After nearly 32 hours of continuous negotiations, many of the bargainers went home at about 6 p.m. (EST) to get some much needed rest," Licari said.

Licari said a tentative agreement between the two sides was not expected to be reached by the bargainers that remained at the table Thursday night. He declined to identify the areas of continued discussion.
Negotiations for a new pact covering GM's 215,000 hourly UAW workers had been underway non-stop since 10 a.m. Wednesday, marking the longest single bargaining session since talks began in June.
